heading.en: A choice that can change a life

hook.en: Many adults who are addicted today first tried a drug or alcohol as teenagers, out of curiosity or peer pressure. Knowing the facts helps you say no.
hook.kn: ಇಂದು ವ್ಯಸನಿಗಳಾಗಿರುವ ಅನೇಕರು ಹದಿಹರೆಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಕುತೂಹಲ ಅಥವಾ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರ ಒತ್ತಡದಿಂದ ಮೊದಲ ಬಾರಿ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿದರು. ಸತ್ಯ ತಿಳಿದರೆ 'ಬೇಡ' ಎನ್ನಲು ಸುಲಭ.

narration.en: Many adults who are addicted today first tried a drug or alcohol as teenagers, out of curiosity or peer pressure. Knowing the facts helps you say no.
narration.kn: ಇಂದು ವ್ಯಸನಿಗಳಾಗಿರುವ ಅನೇಕರು ಹದಿಹರೆಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಕುತೂಹಲ ಅಥವಾ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರ ಒತ್ತಡದಿಂದ ಮೊದಲ ಬಾರಿ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿದರು. ಸತ್ಯ ತಿಳಿದರೆ 'ಬೇಡ' ಎನ್ನಲು ಸುಲಭ.

body.en: Opioids bind to opioid receptors in the central nervous system and gastrointestinal tract. Heroin (smack), chemically diacetylmorphine, is a white, odourless, bitter crystal obtained by acetylation of morphine, which is extracted from the latex of the poppy, Papaver somniferum; heroin is a depressant and slows body functions. Cannabinoids from Cannabis sativa (marijuana, hashish, charas, ganja) interact with cannabinoid receptors in the brain and affect the cardiovascular system. Cocaine, from the coca plant Erythroxylum coca, interferes with the transport of the neurotransmitter dopamine, gives a sense of euphoria and increased energy, and in excess causes hallucinations. Atropa belladonna and Datura have hallucinogenic properties. Morphine is a very effective sedative and painkiller used in surgery.
body.kn: ಒಪಿಯಾಯ್ಡ್‌ಗಳು ನರವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಯ ಗ್ರಾಹಕಗಳಿಗೆ ಬಂಧಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಹೆರಾಯಿನ್ ಗಸಗಸೆ ಸಸ್ಯದ ಮಾರ್ಫಿನ್‌ನಿಂದ ತಯಾರಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಖಿನ್ನಕಾರಕ. ಕ್ಯಾನಬಿನಾಯ್ಡ್‌ಗಳು ಗಾಂಜಾ ಸಸ್ಯದಿಂದ. ಕೊಕೇನ್ ಡೋಪಮೈನ್ ಸಾಗಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಡ್ಡಿಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಧತ್ತೂರಿ ಭ್ರಮೆ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Commonly abused drugs: heroin from the poppy, cannabinoids from Cannabis sativa, cocaine from Erythroxylum coca, and nicotine in tobacco.
Heroin is diacetylmorphine, made by acetylation of morphine. It slows down body functions.
In adolescence, curiosity and peer pressure can lead to repeated use, then addiction and dependence; stopping suddenly brings withdrawal symptoms.
Long-term effects: alcohol damages the liver, causing cirrhosis; smoking causes lung cancer and emphysema and raises carbon monoxide in the blood. Help comes from talking and seeking help early.

body.en: Tobacco contains nicotine, an alkaloid that stimulates the adrenal gland to release adrenaline and nor-adrenaline into the blood, raising blood pressure and heart rate. Smoking is linked to cancers of the lung, urinary bladder and throat, bronchitis, emphysema, coronary heart disease and gastric ulcer; it raises carbon monoxide in the blood and lowers the oxygen supply. Adolescence (12–18 years) is a vulnerable phase; curiosity, peer pressure and the urge to escape stress lead to drug and alcohol use. Repeated use causes addiction and dependence, with withdrawal symptoms when stopped. Chronic alcohol use damages the nervous system and liver (cirrhosis). Prevention: avoid undue peer pressure, education and counselling, seeking help from parents and peers, watching for danger signs, and professional and medical help.
body.kn: ತಂಬಾಕಿನ ನಿಕೋಟಿನ್ ಅಡ್ರಿನಲ್ ಗ್ರಂಥಿಯಿಂದ ಅಡ್ರಿನಾಲಿನ್ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ಮಾಡಿಸಿ ರಕ್ತದೊತ್ತಡ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಹದಿಹರೆಯ (12–18 ವರ್ಷ) ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ ಹಂತ. ವ್ಯಸನ ಮತ್ತು ಅವಲಂಬನೆ; ಮದ್ಯ ಯಕೃತ್ತಿಗೆ ಹಾನಿ. ತಡೆಗಟ್ಟುವಿಕೆಗೆ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ, ಸಲಹೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಹಾಯ ಪಡೆಯುವುದು ಮುಖ್ಯ.

points.en: Nicotine → adrenaline, noradrenaline → higher BP and heart rate
Smoking: CO in blood, lung cancer, emphysema
Alcohol: liver cirrhosis; seek help early

caption.en: Turn the brain. Opioids, cannabinoids and cocaine act on receptors and messengers in the brain, which is why they change mood, judgement and body control.

narration.en: Turn the brain model. Drugs such as opioids, cannabinoids and cocaine act on receptors and chemical messengers in the brain. That is why they change mood and judgement, and why repeated use leads to dependence.

problem.en: Match each drug to its source and main effect: heroin, cocaine, marijuana.

steps.en: Heroin: made by acetylation of morphine from the poppy Papaver somniferum; a depressant that slows body functions.
Cocaine: from Erythroxylum coca; interferes with dopamine transport and is a strong stimulant of the CNS.
Marijuana: from Cannabis sativa; acts on cannabinoid receptors and affects the cardiovascular system.

answer.en: Heroin – poppy – depressant; cocaine – coca – stimulant; marijuana – Cannabis – cardiovascular effects
